_comment: The only file you edit. Pick the dataset folder under datasets/, enable the policies you want, set compute. Registry facts per policy (training flags, tier, VRAM, licence class) live in trainer/policies/*.yaml and are maintained with the repo, not here. CLI flags of ./finetune.sh override anything below for one run.

secrets._comment: Name of an AWS Secrets Manager secret holding a Hugging Face token. Needed only for gated base weights (pi0 / pi0.5 / pi0_fast PaliGemma tokenizer, GR00T Cosmos-Reason2 processor); read once by the base-weight staging job, never by a training job (training runs with network isolation on).

dataset.name: so101-4tasks-100eps
dataset._comment: public 4-task SO-101 set; anonymous uploader, Apache-2.0 as a card tag only: accept that licence yourself (docs/DATASETS.md)

evaluation._comment: small held-out set: autoregressive decoders make every evaluated frame expensive

compute._comment: one 80 GB GPU (ml.p5.4xlarge H100, or ml.g7e.4xlarge, untested); Spot quota is often granted before on-demand.

smoke._comment: Before every training job a 200-step job on the same instance proves the image, dataset and flags (< $1). reuse=true skips it when an identical smoke already passed.

policies._comment: The three registry entries that need an 80 GB GPU (pi0_fast, eo1, fastwam). accept_licence acknowledges the publishers' terms (docs/POLICIES.md). eo1 (research-only) and fastwam (unknown licence) also need approval_ref: the plan refuses both entries while it is null, so fill in your own reference (who read the terms, and where that is recorded) before running.

image._comment: ECR tag the deploy-time CodeBuild image build pushes. Read by cdk/app.py; training jobs pin the image by digest (SSM /<project>/image_uri), never by tag.
